description: Get the questions for one EQIQs framework so the user can take it inside the chat. Ask them one at a time, word for word, accepting only A or B. Call with no framework to list what the user has not completed yet. Personal frameworks (attachment, love language) need the user's explicit consent. Read-only; costs 1 unit.

framework.description: Framework key, e.g. 'mbti', 'disc', 'enneagram', 'big_five'. Omit to list remaining frameworks.
